title: cli(migrate organization-ownership --apply): with an existing `--out` file, the ceremony executes every step and then refuses `apply_refused` / `report-file-unwritable`, which under `--json` reads as if nothing ran
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a defect measured at a public door**, on staging's v18 control-plane ceremony (objectstack-ai/cloud#2899, comment `6208078528`). The os-dev on objectstack-ai/cloud#2902 traced it in code. Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`); the seat re-read the lines below on `main`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: a search for `organization-ownership apply --out report-file-unwritable` gives 1 hit, #23562 (closed, the plan arm's WAL conversion), which is not this. No open card names the apply's report order.

## What happens

On staging, a second `os migrate organization-ownership --apply --json --out <same file>` executed every remaining step: rewrite, mirror deletion 858, and 17 column drops. It then exited 1 with `apply_refused` / `report-file-unwritable` (`EEXIST`). The operator reads that as "the apply refused", the same word a refusal before any write prints.

## Where (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts`, at `534ca13eb5` and still on `main`)

- The ceremony runs at `:579-687`.
- The report is written only afterwards, with flag `wx`, at `:719-721`.
- The refusal at `:722-728` goes through `:232-239` under `--json`. It prints the same `apply_refused` code as a pre-write refusal (for example `:690-692`), and drops the human sentence "The ceremony ran" (`:725`).
- The plan path has the same order (`:388-396`) but writes nothing.

## Done when

An `--apply` whose `--out` cannot be written refuses before executing anything. Or, if it has already executed, its JSON payload names that executed state with a code distinct from a pre-write refusal. Either way, a regression test covers an existing `--out`.

cloud's runbook (objectstack-ai/cloud PR #2903) works around this: every run gets a fresh, time-stamped path, and 2.7 reads a refused run from the marker. The fix is still owed for any other operator of the ceremony.
